# 从AI零基础到vLLM贡献者知识图谱

## 模型优化策略概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    WM["World Model"] --> FA["Focus Area (high precision)"]
    WM --> BA["Background Area (low precision)"]
    FA --> FG["Fine Image Generation"]
    BA --> CG["Coarse Image Generation"]
    FG --> TG["Trade‑off: Detail vs Compute"]
    CG --> TG
    SR["Step Reduction (e.g., 50→25 steps)"] --> TG
    MG["Coarse + Fine on same machine"] --> TG
    TG --> MG
```

## 开源贡献工作流
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S1["Start with minimal model"] --> R1["Run model successfully"]
    R1 --> D1["Read README & docs"]
    D1 --> UT["Run unit tests"]
    UT --> B1["Identify model‑level bugs"]
    B1 --> F1["Fix model‑level bugs"]
    UT --> B2["Identify framework bugs"]
    B2 --> F2["Fix framework bugs"]
    F1 --> PR1["Create PR (<1000 lines)"]
    F2 --> PR1
    PR1 --> SP["Split PR if >1000 lines"]
    SP --> CR["Code Review & community feedback"]
    CR --> M1["Merge into main repo"]
    M1 --> C1["Become committer"]
    C1 --> C2["Continue contributions"]
```

## 资源与算力管理
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    REQ["Compute Requirement"] --> MIN["Minimum 2 GPUs"]
    MIN --> RENT["Rent GPUs (cloud)"]
    RENT --> COST["Cost ≈ $0.30‑0.40 per GPU·hour"]
    REQ --> LWA["Layer‑wise adaptation (single GPU)"]
    LWA --> SMALL["Use small models (e.g., 0.8‑B)"]
    SMALL --> RUN["Run locally on one GPU"]
    REQ --> COARSE["Coarse generation for background"]
    COARSE --> SAVE["Save compute"]
    LWA --> SAVE
    SAVE --> OPT["Optimize overall workflow"]
```
